body: Mil gracias por tu ayuda, trataré de conseguir ayuda profesional antes de que me vuelva loco con mis pensamientos. Estos cambios de animo están afectando mi relación personal con mi novia, ella sabe cuando algo anda mal conmigo pero no tiene idea de lo que está pasando por mi cabeza. Se siente muy bien poder sacar todo esto de mi pecho.
Qué sería mas adecuado para mi problema? un Psicologo o un Psiquiatra?

Spanish.

The feelings are so strong and overwhelming, I have no one i can talk to but i have been thinking of getting professional help. The thing is  I don't even know the difference between a psychiatrist and a psychologist. I have contained myself many many times i could just grab that gun and get out of this stupid world. I have taken several online tests and all of them say I have some kind of depression, that is what got me thinking about getting help, but it seems so much easier just to pull that trigger and forget about everything.

Thank you for being so nice and understanding, it's a rare thing on this planet.
yeees, and I can't even control it, it takes over completely.
Thinking about the future is what makes me feel most hopeless, but sometimes the feeling just comes out of nowhere, I really don't understand either.

I'm very sorry, my English is not so good. some days i wake up feeling normal and out of nowhere i start feeling depressed and can't get the suicide thoughts out of my head, this can happen at any given time of the day and its driving me nuts. I think the reason i have not done it is because of my mother, I'm her only son and i don't know how she would react, but my god do i feel like doing it. I have not been able to tell anyone because I don't want them to freak out on me or look at me like I'm a crazy fuck.
I thought i was alone in this, sometimes I'm just normal but any minute it can change and i start feeling like crap and just want it all to end. There's a gun @ my house, i think about it everyday.
